lines.trans: Here you go, Katya, this is specially for you.
Hot cocoa with sweet little marshmallows!
I have adored it since early childhood.
Tell me, how did you find out about that?
It seems to me there is a cosmic bond between us.
Some higher intelligence is guiding me.
Well then, is it really tasty for you?
Katya, did you just kiss a waiter?
Now you will start turning into a waitress!
Well fine, there is nothing terrible about that.
After all, you do not turn into Senya.
Have a nice time staying here, young lovebirds!

meanings.note: Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to stay, remain', paired with 'остаться'.

examples.text: Счастливо вам оставаться, молодые голубки!
examples.trans: Have a nice time staying here, young lovebirds!

examples.text: Аванс остаётся у нас.
examples.trans: The advance stays with us.

examples.text: Я остаюсь дома.
examples.trans: I'm staying at home.

meanings.note: Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('young').

examples.text: Счастливо вам оставаться, молодые голубки!
examples.trans: Have a nice time staying here, young lovebirds!

examples.text: Подумай хорошо, ты ведь такой молодой.
examples.trans: Think carefully, you are so young after all.

examples.text: Вот же настоящий молодой самоубийца!
examples.trans: What a real young daredevil!

meanings.note: Common feminine noun meaning 'dove (female), pigeon' in everyday Russian.

examples.text: Счастливо вам оставаться, молодые голубки!
examples.trans: Have a nice time staying here, young lovebirds!

examples.text: Ну и кто же теперь из нас голубок?
examples.trans: Well, and which one of us is the lovebird now?

examples.text: Белая голубка.
examples.trans: White dove.
